questions.prompt: A production agent must answer in <800 ms while a slower frontier model may take seconds. Define an authority architecture that prevents late reasoning from rewriting an already committed action.

late result can affect later state or memory only

questions.prompt: Explain why increasing reasoning effort is not a universal substitute for deterministic structural authority. Give one falsifiable experimental contrast.
gold: more compute can still violate canonical invariants
quality measured independently of token count

questions.prompt: Design a gate that chooses cheap inference first and escalates once to deep reasoning only when structurally insufficient. State the rule and the main economic confound.
